results.title: Types of Carbonate Electrolytes Used in Batteries
results.content:
Ethylene carbonate (EC) is one of the most important components in carbonate electrolyte systems. It has a high dielectric constant, which helps dissolve lithium salts efficiently.

EC plays a crucial role in:

 Forming a stable SEI (solid electrolyte interphase) layer
 Improving battery stability
 Enhancing cycle life

However, EC has high viscosity, so it is usually mixed with other solvents.

### Dimethyl Carbonate (DMC) [...] A carbonate electrolyte is a liquid solution composed of lithium salts dissolved in organic carbonate solvents. These electrolytes act as a medium for lithium-ion transport between the anode and cathode.

Their effectiveness depends largely on the type of carbonate solvent used, which directly impacts battery performance, safety, and lifespan.
